name: Barcelos (Câmara Municipal de Barcelos)
verdict: The 'BARCELOS' mark on the upper back is the town council of Barcelos sponsoring in its own name; a Portuguese municipal government. Nothing found.
note: Proposed none 2026-10-03 (issue #394): the club's partners page lists Barcelos as an OFFICIAL SPONSOR linking to cm-barcelos.pt. State ownership alone is not a tier; no UN, Amnesty, HRW, court or regulator human-rights finding against the Município de Barcelos was found, so nothing found.
